sections.name: Free GPU / Notebook Compute
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Platform cards with GPU type, weekly/monthly quota, session limits, signup requirements, and direct notebook URL
sections.whyWorthSection: Core need for training/fine-tuning without local hardware; quotas change frequently and stacking multiple is standard practice among LocalLLaMA/selfhosted users

sections.name: Free Datasets
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Dataset cards with size, license, modality (text/image/tabular), download count, and direct HF/Kaggle link
sections.whyWorthSection: Essential for local training, RAG, and evaluation; power users constantly need high-quality free sources beyond built-in bookmarks

sections.name: Free Prompt Libraries & System Prompts
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Repo or collection cards with prompt count, target tools (Cursor/Claude/etc), license, and GitHub URL
sections.whyWorthSection: Cursor rules, agent system prompts, and custom instructions are high-value for AI coding workflows and missing from current categories

sections.name: Free MCP Servers
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Server cards with install command (npx/uvx), category (filesystem/browser/db), transport, and GitHub URL
sections.whyWorthSection: MCP is the emerging standard for agent tool use; free/local servers are heavily discussed on r/LocalLLaMA and missing from Tools/Bookmarks

sections.name: Free Vector Databases
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: DB cards with free storage/objects limit, self-host option, hybrid search support, and pricing page URL
sections.whyWorthSection: RAG and local agent memory require vector stores; free hosted + self-host options are a frequent pain point

sections.name: Free Hosting & Deploy Tiers
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Platform cards with bandwidth, build minutes, cold-start behavior, commercial-use flag, and pricing URL
sections.whyWorthSection: Deploying demos, agents, and frontends is core; free-for.dev style lists are heavily referenced

sections.name: Student / OSS Credit Programs
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Program cards with eligibility, credit amount/value, duration, and application URL
sections.whyWorthSection: One verification unlocks hundreds of dollars in credits; high ROI for the target audience

sections.name: Free AI Courses
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Course cards with provider, length, certificate flag, level, and direct start URL
sections.whyWorthSection: Structured learning paths are frequently requested; free certificates and practical courses fill a gap

sections.name: Free Voice / TTS Models
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Model cards with size, license (commercial?), languages, VRAM/CPU needs, and HF/GitHub URL
sections.whyWorthSection: Local voice agents and offline TTS are popular in selfhosted/LocalLLaMA; licensing and size matter

sections.name: Benchmark Leaderboards
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Leaderboard cards with ranking method, update frequency, open-weight filter, and live URL
sections.whyWorthSection: Choosing which free/local model to run requires current rankings; leaderboards change weekly

sections.name: Free Auth / DB / Storage Tiers
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Service cards with free limits (MAU, storage, bandwidth), pause behavior, and pricing URL
sections.whyWorthSection: Backend building blocks for AI apps; free tiers with auth+DB+storage are heavily used

sections.name: Free CI / Build Minutes
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: CI cards with monthly minutes, concurrent jobs, and pricing/docs URL
sections.whyWorthSection: CI for open-source and personal projects is a daily need; free minutes are limited and tracked

sections.name: Hugging Face Spaces Worth Bookmarking
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Space cards with likes, ZeroGPU flag, category (image/video/agent), and direct Space URL
sections.whyWorthSection: ZeroGPU Spaces give free inference demos; trending Spaces are high-signal discovery

sections.name: Free AI Newsletters & Changelogs
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Newsletter cards with frequency, focus (models/tools/papers), and subscribe URL
sections.whyWorthSection: Staying current on free-tier changes and new models requires curated feeds

sections.name: Browser Extensions for AI Power Users
sections.whatEntriesLookLike: Extension cards with store link, permissions, free flag, and primary use case
sections.whyWorthSection: Browser tooling for scraping, prompt injection testing, and API inspection complements local AI workflows

offlineFirstLaunchData.description: Snapshot data that remains useful without internet or on first launch before any sync
items: Cached rate-limit matrix (last known free quotas for 50+ APIs with rotation strategy)
Static bookmark list of pure-client utilities (converters, formatters, calculators that work offline once loaded)
Local runtime detection results (Ollama/LM Studio/Jan presence and model list)
Pre-seeded Key Vault schema + empty encrypted store (so user can add keys immediately)
IDE/agent config templates (Cursor rules, Continue.dev, Aider, etc.) as local files
Offline-capable prompt/system-prompt snippets (top 20 Cursor rules and system prompts)
Last-known free-tier change log (stale warnings for entries older than 30 days)
Local model recommendation matrix (GGUF sizes vs VRAM for popular models)
MCP server install commands and minimal configs that can be copied offline
GitHub Student Pack partner list (static) with application URLs for later claim
